data.narrative:
AtmoCooling is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Paul Mahacek and Paul-Emmanuel Herve that has raised $3.6M to date. The Climate & Energy sector includes 8 private peers (Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Enovix) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though narrow peer matching at identical stage and valuation tier proved limited.

Valuation analysis relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. Using the $3.6M total raised as a proxy for seed valuation and applying this multiplier yields an implied valuation of $9M. Peer-Median comparison was not applicable; while 8 same-sector companies exist, zero fell within sufficient overlap on stage and tier after filtering, preventing reliable median benchmarking at the required three-datapoint minimum.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $10M (median $9M), derived from a single methodological anchor. Key uncertainties include the stage-progression multiplier's applicability to AtmoCooling's specific capital efficiency and market timing, and the absence of direct peer validation. Refinement of this range would benefit from either closer comparable companies at identical seed-stage positioning or forward-looking metrics on product development and customer traction.
